title: Diagnostic value and immune infiltration characterization of YTHDF2 as a critical m6A regulator in osteoarthritic synovitis.
authors: Bian, Ashuai; Wang, Changming; Zhang, Haotian; Yan, Yiqun; Zhang, Linlin; Cheng, Wendan
journal: Journal of orthopaedic surgery and research
one_liner_zh: 该文研究m6A调控因子YTHDF2在骨关节炎滑膜炎中的诊断价值与免疫浸润，属于RNA修饰与疾病生物标志物研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: N6-methyladenosine (m6A) is a universal RNA modification pattern regulated by multiple m6A regulators. In osteoarthritis (OA), m6A regulators influence disease progression by regulating cartilage degradation. However, the function of m6A regulators in synovial tissue remains unclear. In this work, we investigated the biological significance of m6A regulators in osteoarthritic synovitis. METHODS: Datasets were acquired from Gene Expression Omnibus. Differential analysis of merged data identified the differentially expressed m6A regulators. Machine learning models were used to evaluate genetic importance. To predict disease risk, a nomogram was constructed based on above m6A regulators. Cluster analysis divided the OA sample into different subgroups. Immune infiltration revealed the immune m6A regulators, which were validated using clinical samples. Eventually, a competing endogenous RNA (ceRNA) network was constructed. RESULTS: We acquired five differentially expressed m6A regulators and a random forest model. The nomogram accurately predicted disease risk. We identified 122 differentially expressed genes between two m6A subgroups. The analysis of immune infiltration showed that YTHDF2 was an immune-related m6A regulator closely related with macrophages. In clinical samples, the protein and mRNA contents of YTHDF2 were consistent with the results of bioinformatic analysis. The ceRNA network based on YTHDF2 revealed 75 lncRNA nodes and 19 miRNA nodes. CONCLUSION: YTHDF2 has a high diagnostic value in the synovitis of OA and significantly influences the immune status of patients. Hence, YTHDF2, a critical m6A regulator, may provide a biomarker for diagnosis and immune therapy of osteoarthritic synovitis.
abstract_zh: 背景：N6-甲基腺苷（m6A）是一种普遍的RNA修饰模式，由多种m6A调控因子调节。在骨关节炎（OA）中，m6A调控因子通过调节软骨降解影响疾病进展。然而，m6A调控因子在滑膜组织中的功能仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们探讨了m6A调控因子在骨关节炎滑膜炎中的生物学意义。方法：数据集从基因表达综合数据库（Gene Expression Omnibus）获取。对合并数据进行差异分析，鉴定出差异表达的m6A调控因子。使用机器学习模型评估遗传重要性。为预测疾病风险，基于上述m6A调控因子构建了列线图。聚类分析将OA样本分为不同亚组。免疫浸润揭示了免疫相关的m6A调控因子，并使用临床样本进行验证。最终，构建了竞争性内源RNA（ceRNA）网络。结果：我们获得了五个差异表达的m6A调控因子和一个随机森林模型。列线图准确预测了疾病风险。我们在两个m6A亚组之间鉴定出122个差异表达基因。免疫浸润分析显示，YTHDF2是与巨噬细胞密切相关的免疫相关m6A调控因子。在临床样本中，YTHDF2的蛋白质和mRNA含量与生物信息学分析结果一致。基于YTHDF2的ceRNA网络揭示了75个lncRNA节点和19个miRNA节点。结论：YTHDF2在OA滑膜炎中具有较高的诊断价值，并显著影响患者的免疫状态。因此，YTHDF2作为关键的m6A调控因子，可能为骨关节炎滑膜炎的诊断和免疫治疗提供生物标志物。
